name: Extreme climate: return levels, non-stationarity, compound events and attribution
description: Block maxima or peaks over a threshold, GEV / GPD by maximum likelihood with profile-likelihood intervals, covariates in the location and scale selected by likelihood ratio, return levels, a copula for compound events, a probability-ratio attribution, QQ / return-level / Anderson-Darling diagnostics and a coverage study (pinneapple_analysis.extremes.workflow).
